title: Calvin University (Calvin)
summary: Calvin University (Calvin) is a university in Grand Rapids. This entry compiles College Scorecard figures and related sources; UniRepository is not affiliated with Calvin.

sections.heading: What Calvin is known for
paragraphs: Calvin University (Calvin) is a private nonprofit institution with an undergraduate enrollment of 3,193 students. The university has an admission rate of approximately 70.9%, reflecting its selective admissions process. Calvin is particularly known for its strong programs in business and health-related fields, with business programs comprising about 14.9% and health programs about 12.8% of the total academic offerings. These areas represent significant portions of the university's academic focus, highlighting Calvin's commitment to preparing students for careers in these sectors.

paragraphs: Calvin University charges a tuition fee of $39,350 for both in-state and out-of-state students. This uniform tuition rate applies regardless of residency status. The total cost of attendance at Calvin, which includes tuition along with additional expenses such as fees, room, board, and other costs, amounts to $54,222. Understanding these figures can help prospective students and their families plan for the financial commitment associated with attending Calvin.
